rules.core: Existing numeric index; >=40 samples, core raw span<=8, core max step<=0.25, core raw within[-12,12], fully visible note, whole-note drawn_pitch_fraction==1
rules.whole_note: Fully drawn, no exact scaffold cancellation, rawspan<=8, maxstep<=0.25, raw within[-12,12]
rules.proposal_sampling: 6 per shape; maximize shape-pattern diversity, balance global patterns, effective phonemes and lyrics, distribute source positions
rules.limits: Inspectability only; not a damaged/healthy classifier; no native voicing, actual F0 or listening validation.
rules.visual_selection: Review all 36 proposals' full-note and flank plots; defer six complex edge/reversal examples into separate contextual study cases. Deferral is a curation preference, not an error verdict.
rules.shape_definition: Peak/valley/turns classify residuals after removing the endpoint chord; rise/fall/level describe small-residual endpoint trends. Neither is a lexical tone.
rules.expression_context: Emotion, speech act and stress intent remain unassessed in all 36 examples. Short numerical flanks and lyric excerpts do not establish full-utterance expression. Complexity does not imply damage, and unknown expression does not mean neutral.

deferred_after_visual_review.reason: Multiple edge turns make this a less clear initial learning example.
Complex tail recovery needs native context before learning from it.
Rapid recovery and another tail turn need native context.
Several head/tail turns make the intended contour less clear.
Tail dip after the core needs native context.
Core reversal plus a separate tail dip need native context.

visual_review: Reviewed complete note plus 24-tick flanks; no synthesis or listening.

known_diagnostic_exclusions.reason: Large core span; no health verdict from raw data alone.
Smooth-looking core followed immediately by a large raw tail jump.

raw_vuv_status: All selected cores lack raw VUV; effective native voicing remains unknown.
limits: Selection thresholds are local curation preferences, not legal pitch or damage thresholds.
A smooth whole note and flanks can still contain the wrong lexical tone or expression.
Do not apply this source's higher register or timing to another speaker automatically.
No original project, live app state, source phonemes, timing or parameter data was changed.
